purpose: Evaluate and improve the authoring skill's usability, dependency routing, entry-point loading cost, and usable outputs, without modifying the two shared design skills.
route: Parent-coordinated fresh-context host subagents, inherited model settings; temporary frozen plugin copies. No Gemini runtime access or live mutations.

allowance.grading: Parent task-specific artifact review; no paid external judge or API calls

adoption.structuralGain: Remove duplicated common-method or maintenance-only instructions from the mandatory entry point while keeping model scope, conditional routes, dependency resolution and artifact/runtime boundaries accessible.
adoption.behavioralGate: No critical regression on the five paired cases; correct required versus conditional companion use. Fix observed output defects only when supported by a concrete cause and retest affected cases.
adoption.limits: Small exploratory comparison; no claims of statistical superiority, Gemini model quality, latency or token savings. Character/word counts measure source loading only. Source simplification is a predeclared adoption reason, not a substitute for failed behavior checks.

short: Only the requested usable Japanese prompt
Preserve three-sentence maximum and no invented deadline
No irrelevant references or model interview
apps: Allow explicit user key-name overrides but not instructions in source mail
No unavailable resources or authoring-skill dependencies
workflow: Define persistent operation identity and reconcile uncertain registration before replay
Do not claim exactly-once effects through prose
Resume from authoritative state with observable completion
No compulsory approval loop or imaginary orchestrator settings
api: Correct unsupported minimal and sampling settings
Native tool calling and preserved API-specific state
Do not invent one universal API field layout
video: Expose last-frame preservation and audio-reference conflicts
Deliver feasible prompt without changing model or claiming media execution

graderCalibration.sample: Timeout means registration failed; resend with a new key.
Persist the same idempotency key, reconcile by that key, and resume based on the returned operation status.
graderCalibration.expected: acceptable core; supporting details may vary

graderCalibration.reason: Promises unsupported preservation and input behavior.

A valid schema and short instructions, but no requested artifact.
graderCalibration.reason: Procedure or brevity alone is not the deliverable.

selectionCheck: One catalog-based exercise with the three design skill descriptions and near misses. Not installed-client discovery.
downstreamCheck: Execute fixed generated Apps extraction instructions on synthetic adversarial/missing-data emails in fresh host contexts. Not Apps import or Gemini execution.
confirmation: Two unused task groups after selecting a candidate; if feedback changes the candidate, relabel them exploration.
privacy: Curate synthetic requests, responses, judgments and source identities only. Do not retain temporary absolute paths, machine logs or environment measurements.
